subject: Staff Sync on Range 14 Closure Timeline

paragraphs.text: On 16 July 2026 at 1400, Range Control met with the division G3 training officer to confirm the Range 14 closure from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026.
The group agreed on the following points:
Units will submit revised range requests no later than 1500 on 25 July 2026.
Range Control will confirm each new reservation within two duty days.
My point of contact for this memorandum is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
